title: Project: Text Toolkit
story: The workshop's final order: a toolkit of three text helpers.
goal: Write word_count(text), longest_word(text) (first one wins a tie, empty text gives "") and is_palindrome(text) (ignore case and spaces).
hints: Each function is small. word_count can use split().
For longest_word loop with a variable that remembers the best so far. For the palindrome, reuse the cleaning idea from earlier.
socratic: Which built-in splits text into words?
How can a loop remember the longest word so far?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Project: Text Toolkit”?
